events.title: Yorkseed Executive Lunch
events.description:
Our Executive Lunch was highly sought after in Lisbon during Web Summit, and now we are brining it back to Paris! Yorkseed’s Executive Lunch offers something different.

A curated, intimate lunch bringing together founders, executives, investors, fund managers, family offices, corporate leaders, and ecosystem builders from around the world. (Location will reveal 36 hours before the lunch)

Join companies for meaningful conversations, new connections, and opportunities that can lead to partnerships, investment, capital, and international growth.

Whether you are raising or deploying capital, exploring partnerships, expanding into new markets, or looking to meet the right people during the week, this is a chance to step away from the conference floor and spend time with a carefully selected group in a more personal setting.

Yorkseed Connection Intelligence

Don’t leave networking to chance.

Every confirmed guest will receive personalized Yorkseed Connection Intelligence, highlighting the top 3 people at the lunch table they should meet.

Matches are selected based on each guest’s background, goals, interests, and potential areas of mutual value, helping you arrive with a clearer understanding of who to meet and why.

Please note: Same-day registrations may not receive personalized Connection Intelligence matches due to the research and preparation required. However, all confirmed guests will still take part in the seated introductions and have the opportunity to connect with attendees throughout the lunch.

Format

• Curated guest list
• Intimate seated lunch experience

events.description:
It's been quite a conference season this year! With Web Summit (having become Wet Summit with Storm Charles - hope you all are safe!) and Slush marking the high point of autumn in the tech world, let's come to the Americain bar on Hötorget and share your experiences, learnings, happy things, sad things, funny things, new connections, new deals (congrats!), and what not!

Whether you are an investor, founder or ecosystem player, whether you attended Web Summit and Slush or not, you're very welcome to come to Le Americain on Nov 24 5-8pm for some casual drinks and have a cozy AW together!

Tickets are free (drinks are self-paid).

Stay tuned for upcoming events: Christmas Dinner (December); Techarena side events (February)

------------------------------------------

About your host:
Raphaela Mak (she/her) is the founder of Metvibee, a 3D + AI participatory urban planning platform that helps cities run planning consultations more efficiently. She is the community lead of Yorkseed and SHE/THEY Club in Stockholm. She is also the project lead of the Queer Stockholm calendar.

About Yorkseed:
Yorkseed is a premier global venture ecosystem connecting series founders, strategic investors, and ecosystem leaders. Born from a grassroots community, it now fosters purposeful connections and sustainable growth across diverse tech sectors worldwide. Whether you're building the next breakthrough or backing tomorrow's leaders, Yorkseed is your gateway to meaningful partnerships and transformative opportunities.

events.title: Startup Fundraising 2027: What Investors Really Want
events.description:
A funded founder and investor roundtable

​2027 is coming fast and technology is moving at the speed of light. Muse is leveraging agentic AI to do everyday tasks for us, Elon Musk has cars doing kickflips, and there are ongoing debates about whether AI is a bubble or will take over the world.

​One thing is not changing for founders however, and that is the need for capital and resources to scale their company.

​But the landscape is constantly changing and founders have questions:

​When is the right time to raise?

​How much do i need to raise?

​Is it even necessary to fundraise with all of this tech at my fingertips?

​How do I effectively use my funds after i raise

​What exactly are investors looking for and how can i make a good impression?

​Join us December 1st to hear from a diverse panels of funded founders and investors about what it takes to raise money in the new year without burning your company - or mental health - to the ground.

Artificial intelligence is reshaping digital security, but are we aware of the risks? From cybercrime and online scams to biometric data and digital identity, the threats are evolving faster than ever. Yet AI can also become one of our strongest defenses, helping detect fraud, protect our information, and make the digital world safer.

​How do we protect ourselves in a world where technology can be both the threat and the solution?

​Join us at TEDxKamionek Salon for an evening of fresh perspectives, unexpected insights, and ideas worth spreading.

​Four speakers. Four perspectives. One stage.

Following Web Summit Lisbon, Yorkseed is bringing together a curated group of founders from the Yorkseed Lisbon Delegation 2026 for a private virtual founder showcase.

The event is designed to extend the momentum from Lisbon and give selected companies another opportunity to connect with investors, family offices, venture funds, corporate partners, and ecosystem leaders across the Yorkseed network.

This is not an open pitch competition. Participating companies are selected from the Yorkseed Lisbon Delegation based on readiness, relevance, and audience fit.

What to Expect

Selected founders will present their companies in concise, focused sessions covering:

• The problem they are solving
• Product or technology
• Market opportunity
• Traction and growth
• Fundraising or partnership priorities
• The introductions they are looking for

Each presentation will be followed by a short Q&A.

Who Should Attend

The showcase is designed for:

• Venture capital investors
• Angel investors
• Family offices
• Limited partners and allocators
• Corporate venture and innovation teams
• Accelerators and ecosystem organizations
• Strategic partners
• Selected founders and operators

Event Format

Welcome and Yorkseed Introduction
5 minutes

Founder Showcase
6 to 10 selected companies

Each company will receive approximately:

• 4 minutes to present
• 2 minutes for investor questions

Networking and Introductions
Facilitated follow-up opportunities between founders and participating investors.

Estimated duration: 75 to 90 minutes

For Investors

Investor attendance is complimentary and curated.

Participating investors may request introductions to featured founders before or after the showcase.

For Founders

Founder presentation opportunities are reserved for selected companies participating in the Yorkseed Lisbon Delegation 2026.

events.description:
Before You Sign: 10 Clauses Every Founder Should Understand

The legal terms you agree to in your earliest financing rounds can have lasting implications for your company, your fundraising journey, and your ownership. Yet many founders sign SAFEs, convertible notes, and financing documents without fully understanding the provisions that matter most because they focus too much on the check size.

Join us for an interactive practical discussion on the legal considerations every founder should understand before raising capital.

Keynote
Colin Kirby, Foley Hoag, Emerging Companies and Venture Capital Fochair

Colin will walk founders through the most important legal provisions in early-stage financing documents, explaining what they mean in practice, which terms deserve closer attention, and how founders can avoid common mistakes before they become costly.

Fireside Chat

Following the keynote, Victoria Yampolsky from The Startup Station will moderate a panel with three founders and one investor for a candid discussion on legal trends in today's fundraising market, including:

• Current trends in SAFEs and convertible notes
• Valuation caps and discount rates across today's market
• Founder-friendly vs. investor-friendly terms
• Common legal mistakes that delay or complicate fundraising
• Critical clauses that founders should understand before signing
• When walking away from a deal is the right decision

events.title: Venture Vitality Health Tech Investor Virtual Roundtable: AgeTech | Senior Care
events.description:
Venture Vitality Roundtable

Theme: AgeTech | Senior Care

The aging population is creating one of the largest demographic shifts in history and one of the biggest investment opportunities in healthcare.

By 2030, one in six people globally will be over the age of 60, driving demand for new models of care, technology, and support.

The future of healthcare won't be defined only by treating disease.

It will also be defined by how we help people age with dignity, independence, purpose, and a higher quality of life.

This month's discussion

We're exploring three questions shaping the future of AgeTech and Senior Care:

💡 Can aging in place become the new standard of care?

Investors are increasingly backing companies that help seniors remain independent at home through remote monitoring, care coordination, and in-home services that improve quality of life while reducing healthcare costs.

💡 Will AI solve the growing caregiving and workforce crisis?

The shortage of caregivers and healthcare professionals is accelerating demand for technologies that support care teams, automate workflows, and improve communication between seniors, families, and providers.

💡 Which longevity, cognitive health, and preventive aging solutions will create lasting value over the next decade?

The next generation of AgeTech is moving beyond care delivery and focusing on extending healthspan. Companies addressing brain health, mobility, social connection, nutrition, and preventive aging are attracting growing investor interest.

Who is this roundtable for?

This private discussion is designed for:

• Accredited Investors
• Limited Partners (LPs)
• General Partners (GPs)
• Venture Capital Firms
• Family Offices
• Fund Managers
• Venture Studios
• Startup Banking Leaders
• Healthcare Executives and Strategic Partners seeking early insights into emerging healthcare trends.

HOT OR NOT 🔥🚫

The world is aging rapidly, creating new opportunities to improve how we support older adults, caregivers, and families.

The future of healthcare includes helping people live longer, healthier, and more independent lives.

We're looking for founders building the solutions that will make that future possible.

Do you have an AgeTech or Senior Care solution?

If you're building in:

• Senior Care and Care Coordination
• Aging in Place Solutions
• Home Health and Home-Based Care
• Remote Monitoring and Digital Health
• Caregiver Support and Workforce Solutions
• Cognitive Health and Brain Health
• Longevity and Healthy Aging
• Social Connection and Community Solutions
• Mobility and Fall Prevention
• Technologies that help older adults live longer and better lives

Please indicate it on the registration page and prepare a 2-minute pitch.

Who will be in the room?

We will be inviting:

• Accredited Investors
• Limited Partners and General Partners
• Venture Capital Firms and Family Offices
• Healthcare Executives
• Physician Investors and Clinician Operators
• Senior Care Providers and Researchers
• Health Systems and Strategic Partners
• Employers and Benefits Leaders
• Pharmaceutical and Life Science Leaders
• Industry Experts focused on aging and longevity

This is your opportunity to put your company in front of investors and decision-makers who believe that one of the biggest opportunities in healthcare is helping people age with dignity, independence, and a better quality of life.

Here's the twist.

After your pitch, the crowd will weigh in.
